7.note: “Beriah” is similar to the Hebrew word for “misfortune”.

9.note: “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

11.note: A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. Therefore this Egyptian was about 7 feet and 6 inches or 2.28 meters tall.

14.note: “Baal Perazim” means “The Lord who breaks out”.
